steps.en: Install the app (or run the official Docker image) and start it
steps.zh: 装上应用，或用官方 Docker 镜像跑起来

steps.en: Pull a model from the library and chat with it
steps.zh: 从模型库拉一个模型，直接开聊

steps.en: Runs as a background service: fetches weights, owns the local model store, loads on demand
steps.zh: 后台常驻服务：拉取权重、管理本地模型仓库、按需加载

steps.en: Point your agent at it — a one-command integration, or a compatible base URL
steps.zh: 把 agent 接上去：一条命令的现成集成，或填一个兼容的 base URL

steps.en: Serves a local REST API plus OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints for apps and SDKs
steps.zh: 提供本地 REST API 和 OpenAI 兼容端点，供应用和 SDK 调用

value.en: One command puts a local model behind a stable API your agents and code already know how to call
value.zh: 一条命令就把本地模型放到一个稳定接口后面，agent 和代码照着现成方式调用

sources: https://github.com/ollama/ollama README Get started / Coding / Chat with a model / REST API (ollama, ollama launch claude, ollama run gemma4, localhost:11434/api/chat)
